title: Evidence of the earthquake from the days of King Uzziah found in the City of David (announcement)

verification_log.method: Fetched and read the announcement page

Page states: 8th-c. BCE destruction layer of smashed vessels from collapsed walls, no signs of fire, attributed by the directors to an earthquake and linked to Amos/Zechariah; cites prior evidence at Hazor, Gezer, Tel Agol, Tell es-Safi/Gath

access_notes: Announcement of an Israel Antiquities Authority excavation (directors J. Uziel and O. Chalaf). Page displays date 23 March 2026, while press coverage (e.g. Israel Hayom, 4 Aug 2021) dates the announcement to August 2021 — the page appears re-posted. No peer-reviewed publication is cited; the underlying excavation publication was not identified (reports_on_source_id left empty deliberately).
